name: Generate brain extracted image with SynthStrip (DWI)
summary: Brain-extracts a DWI by running FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthStrip on its mean b0 volume and applying the resulting brain mask to every volume, and outputs the masked DWI and the mask.
description: Averages the b=0 volumes with FSL select_dwi_vols, computes a brain mask from that b0 image with mri_synthstrip, and applies the mask to the full DWI with mri_mask; bvals and bvecs are carried over. Use it when you need a skull-stripped DWI or a DWI-space brain mask. Needs a DWI with bvals that include b=0 volumes.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvecs and bvals.
inputs.requirements: Must contain at least one b=0 volume; the mean b0 is used to compute the mask.

outputs.description: The input DWI with non-brain voxels zeroed, with its bvecs and bvals.
Binary brain mask (mask.nii.gz) in DWI space.

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.cause: The brain-extracted image or mask was not produced.
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log for the mri_synthstrip error.
